about: What an ImgTest2 cell's key covers (contract 1.4). img:PLAT is entries[PLAT] merged over kinds.image; {plat} in a path is the entry's plat. bins_from_image: the bin group is facts.images[PLAT]: restic-bko (not on Haiku), rustic-bko and bko-holt from images/P/bko-bin.sha256, test-image (the pin's sha256, else img:unknown) and release-image (SHA256SUMS' .img line).
notes: A harness or host change alone leaves a cell soft-stale, not due: ImgTest2 tests images built since their last PASS (plan.py's img:new, on the bin group).
img.py's parsing of boot-*.out is the runner, not an input of the cell: a check's own wording is keyed by the checks.sh that prints it.
